::: {#cor-homoskedastic-deviations}
#### Deviations in a homoskedastic model

In a homoskedastic model (@def-homoskedastic),
the deviations (@def-slr-deviation) all have the same variance $\varpar$:

$$\cdev_\iobs \mid \Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs \simind \ndist{0, \varpar}.$$
:::

::: proof
By @thm-slr-deviation-dist, $\cdev_\iobs \mid \Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs \simind \ndist{0, \varpar_\iobs}$,
and @def-homoskedastic sets $\varpar_\iobs = \varpar$ for all $i$.
:::
